notes: The kitchen-designer analogy and the '11 p.m. on a Tuesday when you are trying to run payroll and also, somehow, still a person' construction are genuinely Ephron — that parenthetical self-awareness and the way she grounds abstraction in the specific indignity of domestic life — though Ephron's essays tend to be warmer and more self-implicating, whereas this voice stays slightly cooler and more observational, which costs it one accuracy point but keeps it publishable.
